assets.title: Saved spatial part field

assets.title: Triangle to part

assets.title: Surface computation snapshot
assets.caption: Actual mesh from the relaxation branch, shown in three projections. This is a new native computation snapshot rather than a historical manufactured model.

assets.title: Native contour groups
assets.caption: Ninety contours produced by native OpenNest with recovered inputs and original controls. Spatial groups are recomposed for reading; original placement and historical cutting DXF remain separate masters.

assets.title: The spatial part field
assets.caption: Exact saved contour boundaries; hidden edges suppressed with new planar display faces. No thickness is added.

assets.title: Coordinate envelope
assets.caption: These are source-coordinate dimensions, not a physical survey or a confirmed fabrication scale.

assets.title: From position to profile
assets.caption: Every profile is rigidly oriented to its own plane; source UUIDs and original positions remain in the catalogue.

assets.title: A rigid flattening method
assets.caption: Native PlaneToPlane transform, with no stretch. Catalogue offsets organize the drawings and are not sheet nesting.

assets.title: The recovered catalogue
assets.caption: Outline-only recovery. Holes, kerf, sheet stock and original fabrication labels are not reconstructed by inference.

assets.title: A working connection detail
assets.caption: Schematic only; not a measured original joint or a fabrication-ready drill detail. Separation is exaggerated for clarity.

assets.title: Local-frame evidence
assets.caption: The new inspection definition reads the saved parts; it does not claim to reproduce the original form-finding algorithm.
